papers.title_en: One Act, Many Masks: Effect-Marginal Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.authors: Shaojin Ma, Ruitao Wang, Pengyi Li, Jie Yang, Liangyu Chen, Gangyi Zhao, Hongyao Tang, Yan Zheng, Jianye Hao
papers.evidence: 面向长时程交互任务的多轮强化学习与信用分配
papers.tldr: 多轮强化学习提升了长时程智能体表现，但现有信用分配仍按具体文本响应计算概率比；不同表述可能产生相同可执行效果，导致信用更新与执行效果错位。EMPO 构建效果级代理目标，将共享同一执行效果的多种文本实现耦合更新，并保留原始信用信号、兼容轨迹级与步级估计器。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、Sokoban 上，其任务表现和学习效率均优于强基线。该工作把策略优化从文本表层推进到执行效果层面。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL) have substantially improved the performance of LLM agents on complex, long-horizon interactive tasks. However, despite progress in fine-grained credit assignment, policy optimization still applies these learning signals through response-specific probability ratios. Different textual responses can induce the same executable effect, yet credit differences arising from subsequent outcomes remain tied to their individual textual realizations. We identify this mismatch as credit-update misalignment. Our analysis reveals that credit-text pairing directly shapes policy-update directions, even when the policy context and executable effect are held fixed. Motivated by this finding, we propose Effect-Marginal Policy Optimization (EMPO), which aligns policy optimization with execution-level equivalence through an effect-level surrogate that couples updates across alternative textual realizations. EMPO preserves the original credit signals, integrates with both trajectory-level and step-level credit estimators, and requires no additional critics or rollouts. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Sokoban show that EMPO outperforms strong baselines in both task performance and learning efficiency.

papers.title_en: CORD: Conflict-Aware Optimization for Joint RL and Distillation in Agents
papers.authors: Wenhao Yu, Zhengcheng Wang, Jiahong Liu, Zexuan Qiu, Minda Hu, Shaohang Wei, Jiafei Lyu, Junyan Lyu, Haobo Fu, Irwin King
papers.evidence: 面向智能体训练的联合强化学习与自蒸馏
papers.tldr: 联合强化学习与自蒸馏可结合任务奖励和教师指导，但两类梯度可能部分抵消，混合系数无法选择性剔除冲突分量。CORD将保护目标选择与触发投影条件解耦，按优化器小批量合并梯度，并用最近点闭式更新进行冲突修正。它在三种联合训练配方中提升ALFWorld成功率1.5至15.9个百分点，WebShop的SDAR从60.7%升至64.6%。该工作说明保护方向与投影门控需协同选择，为智能体联合训练提供通用冲突感知优化机制。
papers.abstract_en: Joint reinforcement learning and self-distillation combines task rewards with dense teacher guidance for agent training, but their gradients can partly cancel. A mixing coefficient controls relative scale without selectively removing opposing components. We present CORD, a general framework for conflict-aware optimization of two objectives. CORD separates the choice of protected objective from the condition that triggers projection, and combines the gradients once per optimizer mini-batch. A nearest-point formulation yields a closed-form update and characterizes its first-order effect on the protected objective before optimizer transformations. Gradient diagnostics connect conflict in agent training to lost local optimization progress and motivate selective correction. As a gradient-combination mechanism, CORD can be added to different joint training recipes while retaining their objectives. Across three such recipes, it improves ALFWorld success by 1.5-15.9 percentage points. On WebShop, it improves two of the three pairs, with SDAR rising from 60.7% to 64.6% success. Our analyses explain why protection direction and projection gate must be chosen together, and why the distillation objective and its mixing weight remain consequential after projection.

papers.evidence: 包含预训练课程、中期训练数据混合扩展与强化学习后训练的智能体模型三阶段流程
papers.tldr: 面向智能体命令行系统的基础模型需求，IQuest-Q1 采用稀疏 MoE 架构，总参数 320B、激活 15B。其训练分为稳定预训练、细粒度中期训练与多脚手架多版本后训练，并结合模型合并整合不同专家与检查点。该模型在编程与通用任务上展现能力，并以开源形式发布，支持社区研究。
papers.abstract_en: We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated). IQuest-Q1 is developed through a three-stage process: (1) stable and efficient pre-training, combining Stable SplitNorm, Muon, and muP with a two-stage curriculum whose second stage increases the coding-data mixture, preserving a wide stability margin between safe and optimal learning rates; (2) fine-grained mid-training, expanding the data mixture across domains and formats and progressively extending the context; and (3) multi-scaffold with multi-version post-training, combining SFT, domain-specialized RL, and MOPD across various scaffolds to integrate complementary training signals and strengthen agentic coding capabilities. Furthermore, model merging combines different experts and checkpoints from different stages while mitigating conflicts among their parameter updates. The resulting IQuest-Q1 demonstrates capabilities in both coding and general tasks. We release IQuest-Q1 as an open-source model to support community research and development.

papers.title_en: When to Follow the Teacher: Advantage-Based On-Policy Distillation
papers.authors: Mahdi Sabbaghi, George Pappas, Hamed Hassani, Adel Javanmard
papers.evidence: 基于优势的在线策略蒸馏，用学生自身策略采样的轨迹训练
papers.tldr: 在线策略蒸馏通常让学生在每个状态都模仿教师，但教师偏好未必真正利于当前学生。AOPD利用学生采样轨迹上的教师重要性权重估计反事实优势，对有益教师动作加权、无益动作降权。该估计无需额外rollout或奖励评估，保持标准OPD的采样效率。数学、代码和Medqa实验显示，AOPD在外教师与自蒸馏设置中均优于蒸馏和RL基线。
papers.abstract_en: Online Policy Distillation (OPD) often outperforms offline methods such as Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) by training on trajectories sampled directly from the student. However, standard OPD trains the student to follow the teacher at every state of the trajectory, assuming that teacher guidance is always beneficial. We instead distinguish between what the teacher prefers and what actually helps the current student succeed. We introduce Advantage-Based On-Policy Distillation (AOPD), which weights teacher actions by their counterfactual advantage under the student. Teacher actions that improve the student's expected outcome are reinforced, while those that do not are downweighted.   Directly computing these advantages requires trying alternative teacher actions at each step and running new rollouts from each. Instead, we show that the AOPD objective can be estimated using only standard student rollouts and their terminal rewards. Our estimator uses teacher importance weights on the student-sampled actions to provide unbiased advantage-weighted supervision, without any additional rollouts or reward evaluations. This allows AOPD to focus teacher supervision on actions that help the current student while preserving the rollout efficiency of standard OPD. Experiments on math, coding, and Medqa show gains over distillation and RL baselines in both external-teacher and self-distillation settings.

papers.title_en: Frontier-OPD: Discovering the Edge of Agent Capability and Teaching Agents to Go Beyond
papers.authors: Zheng Jiang, Yiming Chen, Houde Qian, Ling Li, Chaoyang Li, Lifeng Sun
papers.evidence: 基于学生当前策略轨迹的多轮智能体在线策略蒸馏
papers.tldr: 多轮智能体的在线策略蒸馏需要判断何处给教师指导，以及学生受指导后能否继续自主交互。Frontier-OPD以“学习前沿”为切入，将在线经验组织成共享状态轨迹图，用轨迹平衡的师生分歧筛选干预候选，并通过短教师桥接与后续学生续接的一致性评估过滤指导。在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld上，其平均自主性能优于对比蒸馏基线，消融显示候选选择与指导过滤互补，部分ALFWorld设置下额外采集成本还被更短达标时间抵消。
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation aligns teacher feedback with a student's current behavior, yet acquiring useful supervision for multi-turn agents requires identifying both where guidance is needed and whether the student can sustain the interaction afterward. We introduce Frontier-OPD, which addresses this problem through the student's learning frontier: decision situations that remain challenging but admit useful autonomous continuation after brief teacher guidance. To operationalize this frontier, Frontier-OPD organizes on-policy experience into a shared-state trajectory graph, where trajectory-balanced aggregation of teacher-student disagreement identifies distinct intervention candidates while preserving the histories needed for replay. Short teacher bridges are then assessed by comparing agreement over the bridge and the ensuing student continuation with an equally long segment of the original trajectory, providing a behavioral proxy for guidance that the current student can build on. Accepted teacher responses augment ordinary distillation data, and fresh rollouts renew the frontier estimate as the policy changes. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld report higher mean autonomous performance than the compared distillation baselines across the evaluated student scales and teacher configurations, with ablations indicating complementary effects of candidate selection and guidance filtering. In one ALFWorld timing setting, the additional collection cost is offset by a shorter time to a target success rate.

papers.title_en: ParetoRSI-Gym: Can AI Agents Improve Language Models Across Multiple Domains?
papers.authors: Haojin Wang, Yangzhen Wu, Zeyi Chen, Jian Xie, Jiaying Ye, Lili Meng, Shuyun Tang, Shangding Gu, Dawn Song
papers.evidence: 智能体搜索并整理数据用于多领域后训练
papers.tldr: 现有递归自我改进评测多在单基准、静态数据池或蒸馏强模型下进行，难以反映多领域真实后训练中的权衡。作者提出 ParetoRSI-Gym，让智能体在固定初始模型、五领域、工具集与SFT流程下反复搜索数据、筛选、训练并读取分领域结果。实验跨三种智能体、三个基模型、五轮与多随机种子，Claude Code+Opus-5 将代理最优检查点的泛化分数相对起点提升9.2%（+2.3绝对点），单领域最高提升63%。该工作把RSI评测推进到多领域机器学习工程场景。
papers.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires an agentic system to design, train, and evaluate its own successor. Data-driven post-training is a central part of that loop, yet existing evaluations measure it on a single benchmark, where an agent selects from a static pool or distills a stronger model to push one score up in one run. Real post-training is multi-domain, and a gain in one domain has to be weighed against a regression in another. We propose ParetoRSI-Gym, in which an agent searches for data, curates it, trains, reads back per-domain results, and repeats, with everything but the data held fixed: the initial LLM, the five domains (math, code, finance, medicine, science), the toolset, and the SFT pipeline. Generalization benchmarks in each domain separate capability gains from overfitting to the scores the agent optimizes against. Across three agent systems, three base models, five rounds and multiple seeds, the strongest system, Claude Code with Opus-5, raises the generalization scores of its proxy-best checkpoint by 9.2% relative to the starting model (+2.3 absolute points), averaged with equal weight over three base models and five domains, with a single-domain relative gain of up to 63% (medicine on Ministral-3-3B). Further analysis shows that the harness matters as much as the model it drives, and that each agent keeps a unique data selection strategy. We see our work as a step towards evaluation of RSI systems in real-world machine learning engineering.

papers.title_en: EvoRouter: Cost-Efficient Multi-Agent Routing via Insight-Guided On-Policy Distillation
papers.authors: Yitao Xiao, Xu Zhang, Ye Cheng, Shaoyong Guo, Yan Sun, Ziyue Zhu, Sitao Xie, Guo Tong, Haoran Luo
papers.evidence: 面向多智能体路由的洞察引导在线策略蒸馏
papers.tldr: 大规模多智能体服务需联合配置模型、协作模式、智能体数量、交互轮次与技能，配置空间组合爆炸且稀疏奖励难监督。EvoRouter以专家周期性提炼可复用路由洞见，结合特权教师做同策略蒸馏，并用成本感知强化学习优化性能与开销。在19个域内数据集和2个域外基准上，域内平均准确率68.69%，超最强基线7.23个百分点，推理计算成本降50.95%。该自演化闭环把执行反馈内化为路由策略，实现更省成本的多智能体路由。
papers.abstract_en: Serving web queries at scale with multi-agent systems requires jointly configuring large language models, collaboration modes, agent counts, interaction rounds, and skills. However, the resulting configuration space grows combinatorially, while sparse execution rewards provide limited fine-grained supervision for interdependent planning decisions. We propose EvoRouter, a self-evolving multi-agent routing framework driven by insight-guided on-policy distillation. A dedicated expert periodically synthesizes performance-cost feedback from configuration trajectories across tasks into reusable conditional routing insights about capability requirements, returns from resource scaling, and interactions among configuration choices. A privileged teacher combines these evolving insights with current execution feedback to provide dense token-level supervision for the router's own planning trajectories through on-policy distillation. Cost-aware reinforcement learning jointly optimizes task performance and computational cost. Together, these training signals internalize execution insights into the routing policy. The updated policy generates new trajectories that support subsequent insight extraction, forming an execution-driven self-improvement loop. We evaluate EvoRouter on 19 in-domain datasets spanning five domains and two out-of-domain benchmarks. EvoRouter achieves an average in-domain accuracy of 68.69%, outperforming the strongest routing baseline by 7.23 percentage points while reducing inference compute cost by 50.95%. Our code is open-sourced at https://github.com/CenYangtze/EvoRouter.

papers.title_en: Training LLMs for Multi-Agent Collaboration with Verifiable Information Rewards
papers.authors: Keru Chen, Sen Lin, Yingbin Liang, Nathaniel D. Bastian, Shaofeng Zou
papers.evidence: 用可验证信息奖励后训练大模型智能体进行多智能体协作
papers.tldr: 多智能体协作需共享证据、请求缺失信息并采纳队友贡献，但最终结果难评价单条消息价值。CoSIR在可验证环境中用贝叶斯评估器按团队surprisal下降给共享信息与请求打分，并通过自博弈后训练LLM。在Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B和Gemma-3-4B-it上训练后，迁移至七个未见自然语言协作任务取得最高综合分，通用任务仍有竞争力。行为分析显示私有证据披露增加、未利用队友输入的失败减少，提供了可迁移的协作训练方案。
papers.abstract_en: Effective collaboration among large language model (LLM) agents in multi-agent systems requires sharing relevant evidence, requesting missing information, and incorporating teammates' contributions into decisions. Training these behaviors is challenging because final task outcomes provide limited feedback on the value of individual messages. We introduce CoSIR (Collaboration via Surprisal-based Information Rewards), a post-training approach that uses a simple, verifiable environment to teach collaboration behaviors that generalize to more complex, unseen tasks. We propose a Bayesian evaluator that scores shared information by its reduction in team surprisal, defined as the sum of the negative log probabilities assigned to the correct option given each agent's available evidence. Requests are scored by the potential reduction in the same quantity if the requested information were truthfully provided. Separate rewards encourage agents to use the received information in their private choices and calculations. We post-train Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Gemma-3-4B-it through self-play and evaluate transfer to seven unseen natural-language collaboration tasks. CoSIR achieves the highest aggregate score, while its performance in general tasks remains competitive. Behavioral analyses show increased disclosure of private evidence and fewer judged failures to use teammates' input.

papers.title_en: Co-Evolving Acting and Forecasting for Language Agents
papers.authors: Haofei Yu, Yixing Chen, Yining Zhao, Xuyan Ye, Yuxiang Liu, Zhigang Hua, Yan Xie, Shuang Yang, Jiaxuan You
papers.evidence: 在成功同策略轨迹上引入多步动作目标的智能体强化学习
papers.tldr: 语言智能体训练受长程轨迹展开成本制约，标准智能体强化学习仅用终端标量奖励，中间步监督未被充分利用。CoPE 在成功同策略轨迹上加入多步动作目标，让共享策略骨干同时学习执行动作与基于历史预测后续动作，形成时序集成并协同演化。推理仍逐步行动、无额外开销。它在五个基准上优于 GRPO 等基线，ScienceWorld 样本效率最高提升约 2 倍，证明执行与预测可相互促进。
papers.abstract_en:
Training language agents is bottlenecked by the high cost of long-horizon rollouts, yet standard agentic reinforcement learning (RL) learns only from a terminal scalar reward, leaving the supervision in intermediate steps largely unused. Prior work exploits this supervision through value targets that estimate per-step success probabilities or observation targets that fit environment response. Both are hard to construct well: (1) value targets come from the same single scalar signal for each step in the trajectory, and (2) observation targets, such as web pages and terminal logs, are long and noisy and reach only one step ahead. We propose 
ame, which adds a third kind of multi-step action targets. On successful on-policy trajectories, 
ame trains the policy backbone to generate the action sequences that follows each history. Each action is also supervised when forecast from the preceding histories, forming a temporal ensemble that the shared backbone absorbs during training, and this enables acting and forecasting to co-evolve. The policy still acts one step at a time at inference, with no overhead. Across five benchmarks (ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, WebShop, $τ^2$-bench, and AppWorld), 
ame (1) achieves stronger aggregate performance than GRPO and RL baselines with predictive auxiliary targets across simulated environments, while improving overall performance on both realistic applications; (2) delivers up to $1.9	imes$ and $2.0	imes$ higher sample efficiency than ECHO and GRPO, respectively, on ScienceWorld; and (3) achieves these gains with a single policy backbone, without additional models, separate pretraining, or inference overhead. The codebase is available at https://github.com/ulab-uiuc/CoPE.

papers.title_en: World of SWECraft: Agent Collaboration at Scale via Simulated Software Worlds
papers.authors: Shannon Zejiang Shen, Yapei Chang, Qiyao Liang, Benjamin Newman, Jenny Liang, Rulin Shao, Ziqiao Ma, Junjie Oscar Yin, Yung-Sung Chuang, Weijia Shi, Yejin Choi, Luke Zettlemoyer, Pang Wei Koh, Mohit Iyyer, Tongshuang Wu, David Sontag
papers.evidence: 面向多智能体协作的模拟软件世界
papers.tldr: 为理解AI智能体协作如何扩展推理时算力，作者提出Software World框架，用真实且相互依赖的Python包构建可模拟的软件世界。智能体在其中自主发现任务、维护包并协作提升软件效率，研究通信、所有权和资源分配的影响。跨三个世界、八种模型、逾一万小时模拟显示，性能随推理时算力提升，最佳模型使下游效率提高31%。该工作开源框架与轨迹，为大规模智能体协作研究提供平台。
papers.abstract_en: As teams of AI agents take on larger projects and long-standing open problems, agent collaboration offers another dimension for scaling inference-time compute. To understand what makes such collaboration effective and scalable, we develop Software World, a framework for simulating multi-agent coworking in realistic software ecosystems. It comes with a pipeline to create environments of real, interdependent Python packages of different topics, sizes, and dependency structures, which we call software worlds. In a simulation, agents maintain packages in the world with a high-level goal of improving software efficiency, and they are free to discover tasks to work on and collaborate with others. We evaluate agents' work in a world collectively by measuring speedup in hidden dependent packages. The framework allows us to study different elements of collaboration by varying communication, ownership, and resource allocation. We run simulations in three different worlds, totaling more than 10,000 hours of agent work across eight models. Overall, performance improvement scales with inference-time compute, with the best model improving downstream efficiency by up to 31%. We show that most agents can find meaningful tasks via collaboration, but some frontier models can prematurely stop looking for improvements and make little progress. We release the simulation framework and traces to support future studies of agent collaboration at https://szj.io/sw.

papers.title_en: AtomSD: Procedural Atom-Guided Self-Distillation for LLM Agents
papers.authors: Bohan Yu, Pengfei Cao, Kai Tian, Chen Han, Shi-Yang Li, Chenxi Zhou, Junlin Liu, Cao Liu, Ke Zeng, Jun Zhao, Kang Liu
papers.evidence: 从学习者自身成功轨迹进行自蒸馏
papers.tldr: LLM智能体处理复杂任务不仅依赖事实知识与推理，还需可复用的程序性知识，而轨迹或捆绑技能表示难以灵活复用。作者提出细粒度、可独立应用的Procedural Atoms，涵盖意图、时机、行动与规避，并构建AtomSD，从自身成功轨迹持续抽取原子，经原子条件监督与任务奖励优化蒸馏进策略。实验显示AtomSD稳定优于强奖励与蒸馏基线，平均性能最高超SOTA 9.31分。该工作凸显原子级程序性知识对策略学习的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) possess broad factual knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, but solving complex tasks also requires procedural knowledge about how to act. Existing approaches often represent procedural knowledge through trajectories or bundled skills, limiting flexible reuse across interaction histories. This paper introduces Procedural Atoms, fine-grained and independently applicable units that represent Intent, When, Do, and Avoid guidance. Building on this representation, we propose AtomSD, an Atom-guided Self-Distillation framework in which the learner continually extracts Procedural Atoms from its own successful trajectories and distills them into the evolving policy through Atom-conditioned supervision and task-reward optimization. Comprehensive experiments show that AtomSD consistently outperforms strong reward-based and distillation methods, exceeding the state-of-the-art baseline by up to 9.31 points in average performance. Further analyses demonstrate that the proposed Procedural Atoms provide effective guidance, highlighting the value of atom-level procedural knowledge for policy learning.

papers.title_en: DynaWeave: Learning to Adapt through Dynamic Scenario Synthesis
papers.authors: Xuan Yang, Chunxiao Liu, Hongsheng Xin, Hao Xu, Ning Miao
papers.evidence: 自动合成面向LLM智能体的动态训练场景
papers.tldr: 现有LLM智能体训练环境多只随自身动作变化，难以应对其他用户、服务或突发状况带来的外部事件，既有计划容易失效。DynaWeave自动将静态任务改造成可验证动态场景，生成任务需求、环境状态和外部信息变化，用有向无环图组织事件依赖，由执行引擎在交互中触发，动态验证器只修订实际发生事件影响的检查。作者在36个环境收集2095条轨迹微调Qwen3.5，在Gaia2、CostBench和ToolMaze上三个模型尺寸均稳定提升，CostBench完成率提高67.34个百分点。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use tools to complete tasks in stateful environments. However, many training environments remain largely static apart from changes caused by the agent's own actions, whereas external events introduced by other users, services, or sudden contingencies in real environments can invalidate ongoing plans. To address this gap, we introduce DynaWeave, an automated synthesis framework that transforms existing static tasks into verifiable dynamic scenarios. The framework generates exogenous events relevant to each task, covering changes in task requirements, environment state, and external information. It uses directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) to represent dependencies between events and an execution engine to activate them during agent interaction. A dynamic verifier revises only the evaluation checks affected by events that actually occur and retains all other checks. Using DynaWeave, we collect 2,095 verified interaction trajectories across 36 environments and use them for supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5 models. Experiments on Gaia2, CostBench, and ToolMaze show that DynaWeave achieves consistent improvements in overall performance across all three evaluated model sizes, increasing the task completion rate on CostBench by 67.34 percentage points and even exceeding the performance of Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview on ToolMaze. These results support dynamic scenario synthesis as a practical approach to training agents to adapt to changing environments. Our code is available at https://github.com/Miaow-Lab/DynaWeave.

papers.title_en: Uni-Mem: Learning a Long-Horizon Agentic Memory Manager with Unified Online Policy Optimization
papers.authors: Zhiqian Xia, Jielong Tang, Ling-An Zeng, Shixiong Kai, Rong Yao, Hao Kong, Xiao Dong, Wei Wang, Mingxuan Yuan, Siyu Xia, Haifeng Xia
papers.evidence: 面向长程记忆管理交互轨迹的端到端在线强化学习
papers.tldr: 长期智能体记忆管理正从固定流程转向可学习策略，但现有方法难以让记忆构建与检索协同适应。Uni-Mem以共享策略端到端在线强化学习统一两项能力，并提出Stage-Decoupled GRPO交替优化两阶段、用ECA将反馈归因到事件及操作。在LoCoMo与LongMemEval上，Uni-Mem优于最强RL基线。该工作验证了联合学习记忆构建与检索的有效性，为长程智能体记忆管理提供统一优化框架。
papers.abstract_en: Long-term agent memory is shifting from predefined workflows toward learnable policies for memory construction and retrieval. Existing learning-based methods either optimize construction alone or combine retrieval-side online reinforcement learning (RL) with offline construction supervision, limiting co-adaptation between the two stages. In this paper, we explore end-to-end online RL for a unified memory manager (Uni-Mem) that learns both capabilities under a shared policy. However, joint optimization with existing RL algorithms such as GRPO faces confounded group comparisons and sparse feedback over long memory-management trajectories. To this end, we propose Stage-Decoupled GRPO, which alternates construction and retrieval optimization while controlling variation from the other stage within each rollout group, yielding stage-specific learning signals. We further introduce Event-Wise Credit Assignment (ECA), which localizes feedback to responsible events and propagates event-level advantages to their constituent operations. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show that Uni-Mem outperforms the strongest RL-based memory, demonstrating the effectiveness of jointly learning memory construction and retrieval via Stage-Decoupled GRPO and ECA.

papers.title_en: Inherited, Not Invented: Tracing the Provenance of Wait in Reasoning Models
papers.authors: Zhizhuo Kou, Sizai Hou, Long Chen, Jian Yang, Junyu Luo, Jingshu Peng, Wenkai Zhang, Sirui Han, Yike Guo
papers.evidence: 中期训练数据而非强化学习使推理模型获得 wait 标记
papers.tldr: 推理模型中的“wait”常被归功于强化学习，但准确率提升并不依赖该词。作者沿开放模型训练史追踪其频率、位置、形式与用法，并用注入错误测试分析采样输出。结果显示零RL几乎不会创造该标记，它主要随中训练和推理轨迹微调而来；基座已有该词时部分RL配方会放大它，而频率本身不能证明RL诱导推理。这区分了模型继承与RL发现。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is credited with teaching reasoning models to write {wait} before reconsidering a step, yet large RL accuracy gains do not require the word. This view can confuse what RL discovers with what a model inherits from its training data. We trace the word through open models' training histories, reading it with label-free indices of frequency, position, form and usage and an injected-error test, all computed from sampled outputs. We find that zero-RL almost never coins the marker: on bases that lack the word, RL raises MATH-500 accuracy substantially while {wait} stays near absent. It arrives with training data: mid-training in OLMo-3, and fine-tuning on reasoning traces installs it in most models whose base lacks it. Where the base already uses it, both released RL-Zero recipes (OLMo-3, MiMo) multiply it, whereas KL-free GRPO from the same base does not; OLMo-3's recipe wears down its form and makes it a more sensitive but more liberal alarm; RL after supervised fine-tuning barely changes it, and our GRPO recipe erases a marker seeded by fine-tuning. Finally, we show that marker frequency alone does not indicate RL-induced reasoning and caution against LLM-as-a-judge revision metrics, as automated judges can reverse human-labelled trends.

papers.title_en: Working Through Representation: Malleable Workspaces for Human-Agent Knowledge Work
papers.authors: Nan Chen, Long Ling, Luna K. Qiu, Zilong Wang, Yuqing Yang
papers.evidence: 通过可塑工作表示实现人机协作
papers.tldr: 生成式AI支持知识工作，但对话历史难以承载指导后续行动的动态组织。作者提出Malleable Workspace概念模型，描述人与智能体如何形成并修订工作表征，并借其组织在工作环境中推进任务。研究通过概念分析、58篇论文比较，以及MalleableSpace三个月纵向研究（7名有经验用户）提炼设计启示。结果显示系统多支持上下文组装与局部采纳智能体输出，较少支持重组和表征之外的实质性智能体驱动变更。贡献在于为以表征为中心的人-智能体设计提供概念与分析基础。
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI supports knowledge work, yet conversational histories may not capture the evolving organization that guides subsequent action. We introduce the Malleable Workspace, a conceptual model of how humans and agents form and revise a Work Representation and use its organization to advance work within a wider Work Environment. We developed it iteratively through conceptual analysis, comparison of 58 papers, and the construction and three-month longitudinal study of MalleableSpace with seven experienced agent users. Systems varied in what they represented as units and relations. System-assembled context was common; more systems supported local incorporation of agent outputs than reorganization, and fewer supported consequential agent-driven changes beyond the representation. The field study showed how representational roles and organization developed in use. These observations refined the model's account of how representation-grounded action depends on and can change the Work Environment. We contribute a conceptual and analytic foundation for representation-centered human--agent design.

papers.title_en: RoleFlow: Self-Evolving Multi-Role Agentic Collaboration via Structural Adaptation
papers.authors: Yi Ge, Pan Wang, Xuehao Cui, Zian Zeng, Xu Hu, Heng Huang, Furong Huang
papers.evidence: 自演化多角色协作与反事实策略优化
papers.tldr: 现有LLM多智能体系统多依赖预定义协作结构，难以随任务演化而调整，且轨迹级奖励难以归因单次结构编辑的贡献。RoleFlow通过反馈驱动的原子编辑与按需角色合成实现协作结构自演化，并用SECPO在同一链状态对比编辑与无编辑，为编辑相关token分配定向信用。在四个领域七个基准上平均表现最优，较最强基线高4.7分，多跳QA领先3.2–7.5 F1。该工作把结构适应转化为可学习、可归因的优化问题，并展现跨基准迁移与跨执行器泛化。
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems often rely on predefined collaboration structures, limiting their adaptability to evolving task requirements. Although recent approaches enable dynamic orchestration, trajectory-level rewards they apply assign one outcome to each decision, ofen struggling to identify the contributions of individual structural changes. We propose RoleFlow, a self-evolving multi-role agentic system that refines collaboration structures through feedback-driven atomic edits and on-demand role synthesis. To make structural adaptation learnable, we introduce Single-Edit Counterfactual Policy Optimization (SECPO), which evaluates each edit against its no-edit counterpart at the same chain state and assigns targeted credit to edit-specific tokens. Across seven benchmarks spanning four domains, RoleFlow achieves the optimal average performance, surpassing the strongest competitor by 4.7 points. It leads on all three multi-hop QA benchmarks by 3.2-7.5 F1 points and also shows supremacy on mathematical reasoning, web interaction, and code generation. Further analyses demonstrate cross-benchmark transferability, training-data efficiency, and cross-executor generalization.

papers.authors: Angela Tang, Vishesh Anand, Gonçalo Paulo
papers.evidence: 跨预训练检查点研究在线策略软标签蒸馏
papers.tldr: 大模型学习其他模型生成的数据时，可能继承与数据无关的偏好，这一现象称为潜隐学习。论文系统研究硬标签蒸馏与在策略软标签蒸馏，并在多种模型、预训练顺序、语料、规模与架构上追踪该迁移。结果显示偏好迁移稳健存在，且教师传递与学生习得能力在不同预训练检查点分离，角色反转时迁移强度可高度不对称。合成数字序列与去除动物词元的实验进一步揭示信号载体，软标签蒸馏迁移更稳定且训练更省。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models trained on data generated by other models can sometimes inherit traits unrelated to that data, a phenomenon called subliminal learning. We study both hard label distillation, where students train on numbers generated by a biased teacher, and on-policy soft label distillation, where students generate the data and the teacher's logits provide the learning signal. Using Pythia, PolyPythia, and DataDecide OLMo models, we find that transfer persists in both settings across differences in weight initialization, pretraining data order, pretraining corpus, model size, and architecture. Across pretraining checkpoints, the ability to transmit a preference and the ability to acquire one develop separately: some checkpoints are more effective teachers but weaker students, and vice versa. Consistent with this distinction, cross-model transfer can be strongly asymmetric in magnitude when teacher and student roles are reversed. To investigate what carries the preference signal, we construct synthetic number sequences that match the teacher's generated number frequencies but have no dependence on the prompt or preceding numbers and find that these still induce substantial transfer in the hard-label setting. In top-$K$ soft-label distillation, removing animal tokens from the loss reduces transfer, although not completely in the same-model setting. In our experiments, soft label distillation produces more consistent transfer with less extensive training than hard label distillation. The growing use of on-policy distillation in model post-training makes this a particularly relevant setting for assessing unintended preference transfer.

papers.title_en: More: Mode-Optimized Reasoning with Self-Adaptive Effort for Self-Evolving Agents
papers.authors: Dianxing Shi, Dingjie Fu, Tianyu Lei, Wangjie Qiu
papers.evidence: 自适应推理努力的自演化PPO训练
papers.tldr: 自进化训练能借助可验证反馈提升智能体处理难题的表现，但常对所有任务统一投入高成本推理。MORE采用两阶段框架：先建立直接作答、短/长思维链与代码推理的紧凑先验，再用MATE-PPO在生成的可验证任务流上联合学习推理模式与token开销。在编程、数学和通用推理基准上，3B至14B的Base与Coder骨干均获稳定增益，推理准确率更高、响应更短且耗时更少。该工作表明按任务自适应分配推理形式与计算量，可在无精选数据下兼顾性能与效率。
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving training improves the performance of agents on difficult tasks through verifiable feedback, but it often applies costly deliberation uniformly across tasks. To address this problem, we propose Mode-Optimized Reasoning with Self-Adaptive Effort (MORE), a self-evolving training framework that adaptively selects both reasoning form and computational effort for each task. Specifically, MORE follows a two-stage training paradigm: (i) \emph{Stage 1} establishes a compact prior over direct answering, short and long chain-of-thought, and code-based reasoning, and (ii) \emph{Stage 2} self-evolves this prior with Mode-Adaptive and Test-time Effort PPO (MATE-PPO) on generated, verifiable task streams without curated data. By learning mode selection and token expenditure jointly, MORE allocates concise reasoning to tasks that permit it while retaining extended deliberation where it is useful. Across coding, mathematics, and general-reasoning benchmarks, MORE achieves consistent performance gains on Base and Coder backbones at model scales from 3B to 14B. During inference, MORE demonstrates higher accuracy and better efficiency, with markedly shorter response lengths and reduced inference time.
